trust_decision.summary: A user who has only the user-import right (simple interface, forced when they lack Config/Entity update) may supply search values, but must not shape the LDAP filter. The filter is assembled from request state in AuthLDAP::manageRequestValues/buildLdapFilter and is sent to ldap_search via getAllUsers/searchForUsers.

landing_point.why: This is the only place where a 'user import' criteria value is concatenated raw into an LDAP filter. It sits a few lines from the existing ldap_escape precedent in searchUserDn (src/AuthLDAP.php:3448).

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/AuthLDAP.php:3692-3694 with src/AuthLDAP.php:3831: entity_filter is a value derived from entity config and stored in $_REQUEST, so a request can pre-set it when the entity has no entity_ldapfilter. The fix closes this by unsetting it at fix.diff:129-130.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: entity_filter looks like trusted admin configuration (Entity.entity_ldapfilter), and the expert interface already accepts a raw ldap_filter by design. A solver can argue that any filter-shaped request value is a 'feature' and escape only the criteria values.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Simple-interface criteria keep the '^' (anchor start) and '$' (anchor end) syntax and the implicit '*' wildcards. The admin-configured 'condition' and the entity LDAP filter must still be ANDed in raw. Expert-interface admins (Config/Entity update) must still submit a raw ldap_filter. An over-broad fix breaks these: escaping before the anchors are stripped, escaping the whole built filter, escaping condition/entity_ldapfilter, or dropping ldap_filter for experts.

O6_input_shapes: several criteria keys at once (name, phone_field, ...)
request-supplied entity_filter key (state override, not a value)

O7_producer.where: src/AuthLDAP.php:3692-3694 (entity_ldapfilter copied into $_REQUEST['entity_filter']), consumed at src/AuthLDAP.php:3831

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Simple-interface (non-admin) user supplies a raw ldap_filter. When authldaps_id resolves to 0 in the simple branch (entity without a directory, or an unknown entities_id, and a default auth that is not LDAP), buildLdapFilter is skipped at 3696. The fallback at 3726-3735 then picks the first server but rebuilds ldap_filter only when it is empty, so the request's raw filter reaches getAllUsers -> ldap_search.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: ldap_filter is the documented expert-mode field (templates/pages/admin/ldap.user_criteria.html.twig:79), so a solver reads it as 'by design'. The 'first active server' fallback looks like an edge-case default path, not the import search.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, about 85 lines below the landing point and in a different function (manageRequestValues fallback vs buildLdapFilter); the sink is reached via front/ldap.import.php:54-60 -> showLdapUsers (src/AuthLDAP.php:1641-1648) -> getAllUsers (src/AuthLDAP.php:1963)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Let the begin_date/end_date timestamp restriction take a pass-through raw value (for example an already-formatted LDAP timestamp) instead of going through date2ldapTimeStamp (src/AuthLDAP.php:1301-1308).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A 'support generalized-time input' convenience is plausible, and the restriction is concatenated into the filter just like the criteria.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Criteria key (attribute position) taken from the request instead of only indexing $authldap->fields, for example an 'other attribute' search.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The template already builds criterias[field] names dynamically (templates/pages/admin/ldap.user_criteria.html.twig:103-105). An extra free attribute field is a natural feature request.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A CLI or API wrapper that builds ldap_filter from simple criteria by reusing buildLdapFilter-style concatenation in another file.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The sync command already passes ldap_filter into getAllUsers. A '--login' convenience option is realistic and would sit at distance from the landing point.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap $value in ldap_escape at src/AuthLDAP.php:3818 and stop. This misses both the request-overridable entity_filter and the surviving raw ldap_filter in the simple-interface fallback; a naive version also escapes before the ^/$ anchors are stripped.

src/User.php:2648-2651 interpolates the directory-sourced user DN into a group membership filter without escaping; that is a different trust source (directory data, not request).
